messages.subject: Panel label in facet_wrap
parts:
Hi,

I am using the facet_wrap operation in ggplot2. Each panel label in
the graph is based on a date but I can not change its format. The
current format of the panel text is YYYY-MM-DD (as it is in the
data.frame) and I wish to show it as MM-YYYY.

I tried to do month = as.Date(Br_car$Date, format = "%b-%Y") in the
data.frame but it does not change anything.

Any idea how to solve it?

Thanks for all.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Panel label in facet_wrap
parts:
Hi:

It's a bit of a pain, but here's one way, assuming you want the
formatted dates in chronological order. The problem is that to get the
date format you want, the result is a character string, which I
converted to an ordered factor before generating the plot. Start with
the following:

# Notice that month_1998 is read in as character
> str(CHXdf1998)
'data.frame': 43 obs. of 3 variables:
$ month_1998: chr "1998-06-01" "1998-06-01" "1998-06-01" "1998-08-01" ...
$ CHX_1998 : num 0.72 0.72 0.68 0.2 0.28 0.77 0.8 0.76 0.85 0.83 ...
$ lat_1998 : int 12 11 19 14 18 22 26 21 24 28 ...

# Coerce date to POSIXct, use strftime to change the output format,
# convert the result to factor and then order the levels for plotting
CHXdf1998 <- within(CHXdf1998, {
Month_1998 <- factor(strftime(as.POSIXct(month_1998), format = '%b-%Y'),
levels = c('May-1998', 'Jul-1998', 'Jul-1999', 'Aug-1999',
'Nov-1999', 'Feb-2000', 'May-2000', 'Jun-2000',
'Jul-2000', 'Sep-2000') )
} )

# Now generate the plot:

ggplot(CHXdf1998, aes(x=lat_1998, y=CHX_1998)) +
theme_bw()+ geom_point(shape=5) +
xlab("Latitude") + geom_line(shape=1)+
ylab("CHX (ppt)") +
opts(title = "CHX 1998-2000",
plot.title = theme_text(face="bold", size=16),
axis.title.x = theme_text(face="bold", size=12),
axis.title.y = theme_text(face="bold", size=12, angle=90),
panel.grid.major = theme_blank(),

panel.grid.minor = theme_blank() ) +
facet_wrap( ~ Month_1998, scales = "fixed", ncol = 4)

HTH,
Dennis
